parts.title: Part 2: Thuyết Trình Thử Thách Áp Lực Cao (2 Phút)
parts.instructions: Em có đúng 1 phút để phác thảo từ khóa và 2 phút để thuyết trình liền mạch.

cueCard.prompt: Describe a challenging technological or academic problem you faced and solved.
subPrompts: When and where you faced it
How challenging it was to deal with
And explain how you successfully solved it

parts.title: Part 3: Phản Biện Chuyên Sâu Đa Chiều (4 Câu - Chuẩn PEEL)
parts.instructions: Phát triển câu trả lời theo công thức PEEL (Point - Explain - Example - Link), nói 50 - 60s/câu.

questions.text: How has artificial intelligence transformed the way people work and acquire knowledge today?
Do you think students are becoming overly reliant on digital technology and AI tools in schools?
In what ways can advanced technology create communication barriers between different generations?
Should sovereign governments establish strict ethical regulations on emerging technologies like autonomous AI?
